messages:
ravi: Morning — new runtime dev here trying to build the inference runtime on my dev laptop (Ubuntu 22.04). I followed the README but hit a CUDA/cuDNN mismatch during cmake. Error below — anyone know required driver/cuDNN combo?

ravi: ```bash
cmake .. && make -j8
[ 42%] Building CXX object src/CMakeFiles/runtime.dir/kernel.cu.o
/usr/bin/ld: error: undefined reference to `cudnnCreate'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
``` 

oliver: welcome ravi! For our main branch we use CUDA 12.1 + cuDNN 9.x on driver >= 535. But if you're on older driver you'll see that undefined reference. What's `nvidia-smi` show?

ravi: `nvidia-smi` -> NVIDIA-SMI 535.86.10 Driver Version: 535.86.10 CUDA Version: 12.1

sylvia: hmm driver looks ok. Could be you built with a system-wide cuDNN mismatch. Did you set CUDNN_ROOT or point cmake to the right lib directories? Also check LD_LIBRARY_PATH includes /usr/local/cuda/lib64

ravi: I didn't set CUDNN_ROOT. CMakeLists tries to find CuDNN via find_package(CUDNN), but I have system cuDNN 8 installed from distro packages.

oliver: yep that's it. For bleeding-edge we ship recipes to build against cudnn 9 in dev container. Quick fix: install our devcontainer or export:

oliver: ```bash
export CUDNN_ROOT=/opt/redwood/cudnn9
cmake -DCUDNN_ROOT=$CUDNN_ROOT ..
make -j8
```

ci-bot: [CI] Buildkite failed on this branch earlier — linked logs: https://buildkite.redwood/dev/runtime/2345

jamie: if you can't get cuDNN 9, you can also toggle our CMake flag to link against the system ABI-compatible shim: -DUSE_CUDNN_LEGACY=ON but that has perf quirks.

ravi: Thanks — i'll try CUDNN_ROOT path. If the devcontainer is preferred where is it? any quick link?

oliver: devcontainer in repo at .devcontainer/runtime-devcontainer.json and we have a setup script: scripts/setup_dev_container.sh

ravi: got it, starting devcontainer now. appreciate the help :raised_hands: 

sylvia: ping me if you hit kernel module issues — I had to reinstall DKMS once.
